name: dev-workflow
description: Spec-to-ship development workflow for Claude Code: spec, plan, TDD, Chrome DevTools UI tests saved as Playwright tests, race/load tests, report and pull request.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Skills dev-workflow:init (set up a repo), dev-workflow:run (take a feature through P1–P6, or quick mode for small fixes) and dev-workflow:status (where every feature stands), plus a session-start reminder.
